claim_text: Across OpenML benchmark datasets, 930738 of 930751 valid tested dimensions satisfy kappa >= sqrt(n+3).
valid_definition: No repeated values in the dimension.
kappa_definition: Maximum adjacent sorted gap divided by minimum adjacent sorted gap.
verification_gate: Exact historical dataset/task/version manifest plus feature values must independently reproduce every valid/invalid/success/failure classification and all three counts.
falsification_gate: A contradiction must use the exact historical manifest and paper rules, or an identified quantified population; catalog drift alone is not a falsification.
proxy_policy: Current metadata and synthetic controls are diagnostics only and cannot promote the claim.
